connectedApps.title: Connected apps
connectedApps.noneTitle: No connected apps are set up on this server
connectedApps.noneBody: The server administrator turns each app on. Until then, nothing here can be connected.
connectedApps.linkCard: Slack alerts, your Google Calendar, Google Drive and Salesforce.
connectedApps.slack.title: Slack alerts
connectedApps.slack.sub: A short message in one channel when something happens. The GMS posts and lists public channels; it never reads messages.
connectedApps.slack.channelHelp: A public channel. Private channels and direct messages are not used.
connectedApps.slack.inviteBody: Slack takes messages only from apps in the channel. Add the app to the channel in Slack, then save here.
connectedApps.slack.whatIsSent: Each message names the event and the record, with a link. It never includes an applicant's answers, email addresses or amounts.
connectedApps.calendar.title: My Google Calendar
connectedApps.calendar.subFunder: Your workspace's opportunity deadlines, written to a calendar of yours as all-day events.
connectedApps.calendar.subApplicant: Your application deadlines and report due dates, written to a calendar of yours as all-day events.
connectedApps.calendar.yours: This is your own calendar. Each person on the team connects their own.
connectedApps.calendar.whichHelp: One you own. Events are written only there.
connectedApps.calendar.written: {count, plural, =0 {No deadlines to write yet.} one {# deadline written.} other {# deadlines written.}}
connectedApps.calendar.status: {count, plural, =0 {No deadlines} one {# deadline} other {# deadlines}} in {calendar}
connectedApps.calendar.what: Updated every hour. Each event has a title, a date and a link: no guests, no video call, no emails.
connectedApps.drive.sub: Attach files from Google Drive and save as-submitted copies to it. The GMS sees only the files you choose.
connectedApps.salesforce.sub: Import records from Salesforce, read only. The GMS never changes anything in Salesforce.
driveAttach.failed: The file could not be copied from Google Drive.
driveAttach.saveToDrive: Save the as-submitted copy to Google Drive
salesforcePick.sourceHelp: Read grants or accounts, or a query of your own. The GMS only reads from Salesforce.
salesforcePick.youSignIn: You sign in with Salesforce. The GMS only runs read queries and never changes a record.
salesforcePick.heading: What should be read from Salesforce?
salesforcePick.chooseWhatToRead: Choose what to read from Salesforce.
salesforcePick.readOnly: Read only: one query, at most 5,000 records each time.
salesforcePick.grantsHelp: Opportunities with a grant record type, as the Nonprofit Success Pack keeps them.
salesforcePick.accountsHelp: Organizations: name, type, website and location.
salesforcePick.soqlHelp: Start with SELECT. Queries that change or lock records are refused.
awardKit.federal.title: Federal funding
awardKit.federal.paidWithFederalMoney: This award is paid in whole or in part with federal money
awardKit.federal.percent: Federal share of the project’s total costs (%)
awardKit.federal.agencyHelp: As it should read in the statement, for example: the Administration for Children and Families (ACF) of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS).
awardKit.federal.onlyWithBoth: The share kit adds the statement of the federal share of costs only when both the amount and the percentage are entered. Nothing is worked out for you.
awardKit.federal.notSaved: The federal funding was not saved.
awardKit.federal.noStatementYet: Enter both the federal amount and the percentage to add the statement to the share kit.
awardKit.federal.summary: Federally funded: {amount}, {percent}% of the project’s total costs.
awardKit.federal.markedNoNumbers: Marked as federally funded. The funder has not entered both numbers yet.
awardKit.federal.statementDetail: Federal rules ask for this statement in press releases, publications and other public statements about the project. When other funders pay part of the costs, add the dollar amount and percentage paid by non-governmental sources too.
awardKit.downloadFailed: The file could not be made.
awardKit.portrait.title: Portrait card
awardKit.portrait.detail: 1080 × 1350, for Instagram and LinkedIn: both organizations’ names and the program, with no logos.
awardKit.portrait.showAmount: Show the amount on the card
awardKit.portrait.amountHidden: The funder hides award amounts, so the card shows none
awardKit.carousel.title: Carousel (PDF)
awardKit.carousel.detail: {count, plural, one {# slide} other {# slides}} of 1080 × 1350, for a LinkedIn document post. Add each slide’s alt text where you post it.
awardKit.carousel.whatAlt: the alt text for each slide
awardKit.press.title: Press release
awardKit.press.detail: Ready to edit. Fill in the parts in brackets. It credits the funder as “{credit}”.
awardKit.tag.title: Page to tag
awardKit.tag.none: {name} has not shared a page to tag.
awardKit.settings.title: Share-kit settings
awardKit.settings.detail: Your social page, and whether others may tag it when they post about grants you are part of. Only your workspace’s admins change these.
awardKit.settings.adminsChange: Only your workspace’s admins change these settings.
awardKit.settings.pageHelp: The https address of your page on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, Bluesky or Threads. A new address needs your consent again.
awardKit.settings.consentGrantee: Funders may tag this page when they post about our grants
awardKit.settings.consentFunder: Grantees may tag this page when they post about our grants
awardKit.settings.credit: How the press release credits you
awardKit.settings.descriptionHelp: Used for “About” in press releases and on the carousel. Without it, the mission on your public page is used.
accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.disconnectHelp: Disconnecting turns the sync off. What is already in QuickBooks stays there.
accounting.adminConnects: A workspace admin connects QuickBooks. You can then set where payments go.
accounting.quickbooks.sub: Connected through Composio, with access to your accounting records only. QuickBooks Payments and Payroll are never asked for.
accounting.notConfiguredTitle: QuickBooks is not set up on this server
accounting.notConfiguredBody: The server administrator turns it on. Until then, payments are not sent to QuickBooks.
accounting.notYoursTitle: Accounting is for admins and finance staff
accounting.notYoursBody: Ask a workspace admin or someone in finance if you need to see what is in QuickBooks.
accounting.recordKeepingBody: Each grant payment you record in the GMS is written to QuickBooks as one expense, so nobody types it twice. This never pays, schedules or moves money, and no bank details leave the GMS.
accounting.mapping.title: Where grant payments go
accounting.mapping.sub: Set this once. Each payment becomes one expense, with the grantee as the vendor and the award and program in the memo.
accounting.mapping.paidFromHelp: The bank account in your QuickBooks chart of accounts that payments leave from.
accounting.mapping.vendorPolicy: Grantees that are not vendors in QuickBooks yet
accounting.mapping.vendorCreate: Create a vendor with the organization's name only
accounting.mapping.vendorAsk: Wait until I choose the vendor
accounting.mapping.syncHelp: Off until you turn it on. Only payments recorded from then on are sent, once each. If a payment is changed or voided afterward, it is marked for you to fix in QuickBooks; the GMS never changes your books.
accounting.mapping.savedOn: Saved. Payments recorded from now on go to QuickBooks.
accounting.mapping.savedOff: Saved. Nothing is sent to QuickBooks while the sync is off.
accounting.vendors.title: Grantees and vendors
accounting.vendors.sub: Each grantee is a vendor in QuickBooks. The GMS finds the vendor with the same name; you can choose another.
accounting.vendors.byNameOrCreate: Match by name, or create one
accounting.entries.title: Payments and QuickBooks
accounting.entries.sub: Each payment recorded in the GMS next to its QuickBooks entry. Nothing here changes either.
accounting.reason.changed: Changed in the GMS after it was sent. Fix it in QuickBooks, then mark it as fixed.
accounting.reason.voided: Voided in the GMS after it was sent. Void it in QuickBooks, then mark it as fixed.
accounting.reason.removed: Removed from the GMS after it was sent. Check QuickBooks, then mark it as fixed.
accounting.reason.vendorRefused: QuickBooks would not create the vendor. Choose one above.
accounting.reason.currency: Not in the company's currency, so it was not sent.
accounting.reason.refused: QuickBooks did not take it. Check the accounts above, then try again.
accounting.reason.unreachable: QuickBooks could not be reached. It is tried again on its own.
measures.title: Growth measures
measures.onlyOperators: Only OpenGrants' operators can see the growth measures
measures.onlyOperatorsNote: The server's administrator chooses the operators. Nothing about your workspaces is shown here.
measures.intro: Nine numbers from the GMS's own database, each over the last 30 days with its 90-day target. Counts only: no person or organization is named here, and no third-party tracker is used.
measures.m1.name: Funders with an open call
measures.m2.name: Applicant workspaces active
measures.m3.name: New applicant workspaces per published call
measures.m3.what: How many applicants a published call brings
measures.m3.detail: {newCount, plural, one {# new applicant workspace} other {# new applicant workspaces}} for {calls, plural, one {# call} other {# calls}} published
measures.m3.noCalls: No call was published in these 30 days.
measures.m4.name: Funders who joined from an applicant's link
measures.m4.detail: From the link in an application package an applicant sent.
measures.m5.name: Funders who imported their history and opened a call within {days} days
measures.m6.name: Awards shared with the share kit
measures.m6.detail: {shared, number} of {eligible, plural, one {# award} other {# awards}} made in these 30 days.
measures.m6.noAwards: No award was made in these 30 days.
measures.m6.clicks: {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}, {clicks, plural, one {# click} other {# clicks}}, {perPost, number} a post.
measures.m6.noClicks: {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}; no post has reported clicks yet.
measures.m7.name: Organic visits to funder and call pages
measures.m7.target: 90-day target: {multiple}× the first week ({target, number} a week)
measures.m7.targetLater: 90-day target: {multiple}× the first week, once Search Console has it
measures.organic.detail: {weekly, number} a week on average, from {impressions, number} impressions in Google Search.
measures.organic.notConfigured: Google Search Console is not set up on this server.
measures.organic.notConnected: Connect Google Search Console below to see this.
measures.organic.noSite: Choose the GMS's property below to see this.
measures.organic.unavailable: Google Search Console did not answer. Try again in a few minutes.
measures.m8.name: Invited teammates who join
measures.m8.detail: {accepted, number} of {sent, plural, one {# invitation} other {# invitations}} sent in these 30 days.
measures.m8.noInvitations: No invitation was sent in these 30 days.
measures.m9.name: Deals lost
measures.m9.detail: By reason in the table below.
measures.lost.title: Record a deal we lost
measures.lost.help: Choose the reason the organization gave. Only the reason and the day are kept, never a name or a note, so the record never names anyone.
measures.lost.byReason: Deals lost in the last 30 days, by reason
measures.lost.none: No deal was recorded as lost in these 30 days.
measures.reason.reviews: Reviews: conflict of interest, anonymized review or board packets
measures.reason.reporting: Reporting across applications, reviews and awards
measures.reason.procurement: Procurement: single sign-on, accessibility report or security review
measures.sc.title: Google Search Console
measures.sc.intro: Clicks and impressions from Google Search for the GMS's public pages, read only. Pages are counted by kind, never by address, so no funder is named.
measures.sc.connectHelp: You sign in with Google through Composio and allow read-only access. The GMS keeps no Google password or token.
measures.sc.problem.reconnect: Connect again: the connection could not be used.
measures.sc.problem.too_broad: The connection had more than read-only access, so it was removed. Connect again and keep read-only access.
measures.sc.problem.unreachable: Google Search Console could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
measures.sc.noProperty: The connected Google account has no property for the GMS's address. Add the GMS in Search Console, then come back.
measures.sc.propertyHelp: Only the properties that cover the GMS's own address are offered.
measures.sc.range: {start} to {end}. Search Console's figures run about three days behind.
measures.sc.totals: {clicks, plural, one {# click} other {# clicks}} and {impressions, plural, one {# impression} other {# impressions}} on the GMS's pages
measures.sc.byKind: Clicks and impressions by kind of page
measures.sc.noPages: No page of the GMS appeared in Google Search in these days.
